text.p: Tunisian detergents firm Societe des Produits Chimiques Detergents made a 3.003 million dinars ($3.12 million) provisional net profits in 1996, results obtained on Tuesday showed.
It said return per share was 2.5 dinars.
SPCD had reported a 3.015 million dinars net profits for 1995.
Turnover amounted to 28.52 million dinars in 1996, up by 10.6 percent from 25.78 million dinars in 1995.
Detergents production volume was 28,182 tonnes, up by 7.4 percent from 26,246 tonnes.
SPCD last year raised its capital to six million dinars from four million dinars through incorportation of reserves.

The company is listed at the Tunis Stock Exchange since last year after it sold to the public 80,000 shares, 14,000 of which were bought by four foreign institutional investors in the first ever sale of shares to foreigners.
SPCD share was last priced 25.58 dinars. ($=1.04 dinar) --Tunis newsroom: 2161-787538
